inputs.text: [excited] He was 9 meters long — as long as a truck. 3 meters tall — [quickly] as tall as a basketball hoop. And 3,500 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as a hippo and a horse put together!
[gasps] As tall as a basketball hoop, plus the crest?
[confident] Yes. A big duck-billed herbivore, [proud] with his bone spike standing tall on his skull.
